title: Class Badges
text:
AoPS Class Badges is a new feature implemented on August 22nd, 2022. When you accomplish a particular goal that AoPS sets for you, you get a badge. To find your badges, click "Report", and scroll to the bottom.

  • Off to a Good Start: Solve your first challenge problem.
  • Third Time's a Charm: Get an answer correct after missing it 2 times.
  • Phone a Friend: Get a problem correct after starting a thread about it.
  • Picture Perfect: Complete a writing problem with an image attached.
  • What Do I Do Now?: Finish all challenge problems for a single lesson.
  • Completionist: Finish all your assignments for a single lesson, 3 lessons in a row.
  • Catch Up: Do a challenge problem that is past due.
  • Balance in All Things: Alternate right and wrong answers 2 times in a row.
  • Ahead of the Game: Do a challenge problem before the associated lesson.
  • More Math Please!: Complete a homework problem on the weekend.
  • Tinkerer: Adjust your "My Goals" page or schedule in any way.
  • On Tilt: Get 5 questions wrong in a row.
  • Yellow Pig: Enter "17" as the answer to a challenge problem.
  • Gmaaster: Type in "Gmaas" as the answer to a challenge problem.
  • The White Whale: Get the same problem wrong twice on a challenge problem.
  • Waffle House: Edit your writing problem response 5 times before submitting.
  • Off by 1: Enter an answer that differs from the correct answer by 1.
  • On Fire: Answer three problems correctly in a row.
  • Wait a Minute: Enter a wrong answer, then wait a minute before entering another answer.
  • 17: Have 17 of your responses passed to the classroom in one class.
  • 22: Have 22 of your responses passed to the classroom in one class.
  • 41: Have 41 of your responses passed to the classroom in one class.
  • Five by Five: Answer at least 5 challenge problems each in 5 different lessons.
  • Honest Day's Work: Enter "I don't know" as the answer to a challenge problem.
  • Knights of the round table: Finish all the round table lessons.(This doesn't exist anymore)
  • Are you sure? Attempt the same wrong answer again on a challenge problem.(This doesn't exist anymore)
  • Introduction to Algebra A Master: Complete your Introduction to Algebra A class.
  • Introduction to Counting & Probability Master: Complete your Introduction to Counting & Probability course.
  • Introduction to Number Theory Master: Complete your Introduction to Number Theory course.
  • Introduction to Algebra B Master: Complete your Introduction to Algebra B class.
  • Introduction to Geometry Master: Complete your Introduction to Geometry course.
  • Intermediate Algebra Master: Complete your Intermediate Algebra course.
  • Precalculus Master: Complete your Precalculus course!
  • Calculus Master: Complete your Calculus course. Great job!!!
  • Introduction to Physics Master: Complete your Intro to Physics course

There are more courses with their own badges too.
